_readme: ④b（キャラごとの文）。組み立ては idle_loop.py の compose(): HEAD + char + motion + 共通の縛り（sway を含む）。neg は共通の負のプロンプトの後ろに足す。新しいキャラは既存の項目を写して char / motion / sway を書き換える。motion には『膝がはっきり曲がって伸びる・弾む』を必ず入れる（『ゆっくり重く』『わずかに』と書くと止まる）。

rica.char: The slender adult female elf gravekeeper Rica keeps the exact same right-facing three-quarter planted ready stance with softly bent knees. She has silver-white hair with ONE thick braid draped on SCREEN RIGHT, long pointed ears, pale skin and calm ice-blue eyes. She wears a charcoal hood-down long cloak, a dark teal high-neck long-sleeved dress, a long tan canvas work apron with one flat pocket and repair stitches, a brown belt and pouch, cemetery keys, brown fingerless gloves, black stockings and brown cuffed work boots. She holds ONE ordinary gravedigger shovel diagonally across her body: the rear hand at screen left grips near its D handle beside her hip, and the forward hand at screen right supports the middle of the wooden shaft from underneath, with one thumb opposed to four fingers. The pointed metal spade stays low in front toward screen right.
rica.motion: Like a patient fighting game character waiting in guard, she repeats a steady measured rhythmic springy breathing cycle in place: her knees clearly flex and straighten within a shallow ready stance, her hips and torso sink and recover together, and her shoulders and both supported forearms rise and settle as one connected body. She keeps the same lightly forward ready lean, a level chin and quiet focused gaze toward the opponent. Her head and neck naturally follow her torso without nodding. Both hands maintain their exact grips and spacing, and the supported shovel moves with her arms as one rigid object, never swung independently. Repeat the same restrained ready-guard cycle several times, never lowering into a deep squat or changing stance.
rica.sway: Her single silver braid on screen right, short hair tips, charcoal cloak and long apron and dress hems softly follow through after the body and settle each cycle. The shovel D handle, straight wooden shaft, metal socket, central blade rib and pointed tip remain rigid and collinear, with constant shape, length and blade size. Fingers stay attached and wrapped around the handle, and the braid stays on screen right. No digging, no attack, no shovel flourish, no ghosts, no floating souls, no magic, no smoke, no particles, no glow.
rica.neg: deep squatting, extreme bounce, standing rigidly upright, widening stance, leaning farther forward, hunched back, bowing head, nodding, changing grip, hand sliding along shaft, missing thumb, extra fingertips, detached fingers, rubber shovel, curved shovel shaft, bent spade blade, twisting blade, shrinking shovel, changing D handle, digging, shovel swing, attacking, double braids, braid on screen left, changing apron, rising cloak hood, ghosts, souls, magic effects
rica.note: 2026-10-24 リメイク戦闘v6から作成したB（seed5055・crossfade0・39コマ）をユーザーが採用し、ゲームへ適用。初版比較GIFの固定64コマによる不正な戻りをidle-loop-v2で修正し、39コマ固有周期のプレビューを承認してもらった。生成連番は変形していない。crossfade6の再切り出しは不採用。表示高2.10・足元固定・緑残り0。IdleLoopCheckにリィカを追加し、4種の検証と実画面確認が成功。記録はdesign/art/rica/idle-loop-v2/。

hibi.char: The athletic adult female former-naval shield warrior Hibi keeps the exact same right-facing wide planted defensive stance. She has short charcoal hair with one silver-white fore-temple streak, stern gray eyes, a short dark navy brass-trimmed naval jacket, rolled ivory sleeves, brown leather and steel partial armor, dark trousers, a burgundy waist sash and heavy buckled steel-toed brown boots. Her left forearm stays braced BEHIND the one enormous broken oval mirror shield on screen right, guarding her shoulder, chest and abdomen. Her right arm stays freely extended to screen left with the same open gloved hand.
hibi.motion: Like a heavyweight fighting game shield fighter, she repeats a steady measured rhythmic guard-breathing cycle in place: her bent knees clearly flex and straighten, her hips and chest sink and rise together, and her shoulders and shield-bearing forearm settle and recover as one connected body supporting a heavy shield. She keeps the original forward defensive lean, chin lifted and eyes on the opponent; her head and neck follow her torso without nodding. Her free right arm and open hand follow the breathing without waving or grabbing the shield. Repeat the same planted guard cycle several times, never attacking or changing the stance.
hibi.sway: Her short hair tips and tattered navy, ivory and burgundy cloth softly follow through with the breathing and settle. The huge mirror shield stays in exactly the same guarding orientation in front of her body, moving only with the braced arm and shoulder. The oval metal rim stays straight, rigid and constant in shape and size; mirror panels, cracks, holes, straps and rivets remain fixed to that same rigid shield. No shield bash, no shield swing, no second hand touching the rim, no floating shards, no sparks, no fire, no glow.
hibi.neg: extreme bounce, squatting deeply, standing upright, straightening the defensive posture, leaning farther forward, hunched back, slouching, looking down, nodding, waving hand, closing hand, changing grip, hugging mirror, lifting shield, lowering shield, shield bash, shield swing, spinning shield, shield on back, two shields, shield growing, shield shrinking, bending oval rim, rippling mirror, changing mirror cracks, repairing broken mirror, mirror fragments falling, reversed white hair streak, changing hair color, growing hair, camera dolly, camera rotation
hibi.note: 2026-10-21 ユーザーがリテイク版を承認し、正面v1・戦闘v4と待機モーションv2をゲームへ適用。待機v1のA/Bは元絵の歪みで不採用。v2はhibi_s2022の生成コマを変形せず直接使用し、30コマ・16fps・crossfade 0（頭頂19px・足868固定・継ぎ目0.90x）。光学フローによる振幅調整・周期平滑化・固定画像の上貼りは使わない。char / motion / sway / negは採用元の生成プロンプトと一致。別途試した新規プロンプトと除外したseed 2022 / 3033はidle-loop-v2/prompt.jsonに保存。再現・採用・実戦確認の記録はdesign/art/hibi/idle-loop-v2/。

gare.char: The adult red-haired human pirate captain in a black tricorn hat, a long open black and gold pirate coat, an ivory blouse, a brown leather bodice, a short burgundy layered skirt and tall brown boots keeps the same right-facing planted stance. She holds ONE broad flared-muzzle blunderbuss scattergun horizontally at waist height in BOTH hands: her rear hand grips the wooden stock at the trigger, and her forward hand supports the wooden fore-end. Small silver mirror fragments remain inside the muzzle and in the two pouches at her hips.
gare.motion: Like a confident fighting game gunner, she makes a steady measured rhythmic springy idle motion in place: her knees clearly bend and straighten, her hips and torso sink and rise together, and her shoulders and supported forearms rise and settle with her breathing. She keeps her back upright, chest lifted, chin level and eyes on the opponent. Her head and neck follow the torso naturally without nodding. Both hands keep exactly the same grips, and the scattergun moves together with her connected arms and shoulders as one heavy supported object. Repeat the same ready-guard breathing cycle several times; she is waiting, never aiming or attacking.
gare.sway: Her long red hair and long coat tails softly sway and settle after the body, while the skirt and hip pouches follow the same connected movement. The hat stays seated on her head. The scattergun barrel and stock stay straight and rigid, with constant shape, length and muzzle diameter. The silver fragments stay inside the gun and pouches. No firing, no recoil, no reload, no loose shards, no sparks, no smoke, no flames, no glow.
gare.neg: hunched back, slouching, bowing head, exhausted posture, head nodding, extreme bounce, gun recoil, firing gun, muzzle flash, smoke, reloading, aiming gun, lifting gun, swinging gun, hand releasing stock, fingers leaving fore-end, bending barrel, changing gun length, shrinking muzzle, giant shoulder cannon, flying shards, changing hat, hat falling off, skirt changing length, disconnected neck, separate moving body parts
gare.note: 2026-10-20 現行の海賊・散弾砲筒版ガレ。seed 2022 / 5055のv1比較でユーザーはAを選好。v2の髪・袖付近の揺らぎを修正し、Aの同じ周期で振幅0.7・空間平滑化6・両袖と砲筒の形状保持・周囲の連続変形を使うv3 gare_A70_coherent_aligned（30コマ・16fps・頭頂の上下18px）をユーザーが採用、ゲームへ反映。再現・比較・採用記録はdesign/art/gare/idle-loop-v3/。

gald.char: The fully helmeted knight in battered ivory-white plate armor with dark red cracks keeps the same right-facing broad defensive stance. He holds a large pointed kite shield upright in front of his left arm and a straight sword low across his body in his right hand, its blade pointing diagonally down and right.
gald.motion: Like a heavy fighting game character, he makes a steady rhythmic springy idle motion in place: his knees clearly bend and straighten, his hips and torso dip down and rise back up, and his armored shoulders rise and fall with deep breathing. He keeps his chest lifted, his helmet facing the opponent and his shield raised in guard throughout the cycle. The shield and sword rise and dip with his arms while both hands keep their original grips.
gald.sway: His torn ivory tabard and dark red waist cloth sway and follow through with the bounce. The sword and shield stay straight and rigid with the same shape and size. No attacks, no shield bash, no sparks, no flames, no new glow.
gald.neg: hunched back, slouching, bowing head, exhausted posture, sword swing, shield bash, bending sword, bending shield, changing weapon, face visible through helmet
gald.note: 2026-10-16 v1は両案不採用。2022は顔の上下、5055は剣の上下と継ぎ目が不自然。v2の頭・腕の固定も不採用。v1 seed 2022の全身運動を30%へ縮小し、剣・盾・兜の形と周囲の連続性を保持したv4 Aを2026-10-17にユーザーが選択、ゲームへ反映。再現はdesign/art/gald/idle-loop-v4/gald_coherent_v4_a30-workflow.json。

gald_breath_v2.full: A hand-drawn 2D anime game animation of a disciplined armored knight breathing in a steady defensive guard. The fully closed helmet, battered ivory-white plate armor with dark red cracks, pointed kite shield and straight sword stay faithful to the reference image. He remains in the same broad planted right-facing stance throughout. The animation is a small repeated breathing cycle: his chest expands outward on the inhale and settles inward on the exhale, the shoulder plates gently settle with the breath, and the loose torn waist cloth softly sways and settles. He completes the whole inhale and exhale and returns to the same resting guard, repeating this breathing cycle several times with an even unhurried rhythm. His neck remains upright and his helmet stays level and steady, watching the opponent without nodding. His knees remain at the same bent angle, holding a stable height. Both forearms hold a steady guard throughout: the right hand stays low by his hip, the sword stays at the same low diagonal angle with the tip down and right; the left forearm keeps the shield upright at the same height. The weapons are supported, not swung or lifted. The sword and shield are rigid and keep their original shape and length. Both feet stay flat in exactly the same spots. Same helmet, same costume, same colors, same silhouette and proportions. Fixed camera, full body always visible, flat plain green background. Only breathing and the cloth's soft secondary motion, no attack, no flourish, no magic effects.
gald_breath_v2.neg: head bobbing, nodding, head shaking, helmet bouncing, squatting, bending and straightening knees, bouncing body, vertical bobbing, lifting sword, raising sword, lowering sword, sword swing, sword flourish, changing sword angle, shield bash, raising shield, bending weapon, hunched back, slouching, bowing head, face visible through helmet, frozen image
gald_breath_v2.note: 2026-10-16 v2の固定レイヤー仕上げも不採用。ユーザーは顔や腕の小さな動きを許容し、全身の連動を求めている。固定画像を上貼りしたら首が切れたように見えた。v3はv1の全身運動を一体に30% / 45%へ縮小して2秒へ整える。design/art/gald/idle-loop-v3/ のComfyUIワークフローとVPScaleIdleMotionを使い、剣・盾は動かしながら形を維持する。2026-10-17、兜・剣周りを修正したv4 Aを採用（galdのadopted参照）。

hane.full: A 2D anime fighting game character idle animation, like a Street Fighter or Guilty Gear idle loop. The rabbit-eared martial artist keeps the same right-facing fighting stance with both fists raised in guard. She makes a steady rhythmic springy bounce in place: her knees bend and straighten, her hips and torso dip down and rise back up, her shoulders rise and fall with her breathing, and her fists bob slightly in time. Both boots stay flat on the ground in exactly the same spots; she never jumps and never steps. Her body keeps facing right and does not turn toward the camera. Her ponytail, loose hair strands, rabbit ears and the red waist cloth sway and follow through with the bounce. Same face, same costume, same colors. Fixed camera, no zoom, full body always visible, flat plain green background.
hane.note: 最初の試作（640×960・81・seed 2022 で継ぎ目 0.43x）。ゲームには未接続。full は旧スクリプトの文をそのまま持つ

borg.char: The long-black-haired armored swordsman in dark spiked plate armor keeps the same right-facing low stance, holding his huge cracked greatsword in both hands with the blade angled down toward the ground.
borg.motion: Like a heavy fighting game character, he makes a steady rhythmic bouncing idle motion in place: his knees clearly bend and straighten, his hips and torso dip down and rise back up, his armored shoulders rise and fall with deep breathing, and the greatsword rises and dips in time while both hands keep their grip.
borg.sway: His long black hair and the red loincloth sway and follow through with the bounce. The red glowing cracks stay on the sword.
borg.note: 重量級。『ゆっくり重く・わずかに』では止まった（borg 版）。この書き方で seed 2022 が採用

hota.char: The long-orange-haired swordswoman in dark armor and a torn red skirt keeps the same right-facing stance, holding a slender sword low in her right hand with the blade pointing down and forward, her left hand held at her chest.
hota.motion: Like a fighting game character, she makes a steady rhythmic bouncing idle motion in place: her knees clearly bend and straighten, her hips and torso dip down and rise back up, her shoulders rise and fall with her breathing, and the sword tip rises and dips in time.
hota.sway: Her very long orange hair and the torn red cloth panels sway and follow through with the bounce.
hota.note: 透過なし・緑背景の元絵でもそのまま通る。長い髪で周期が閉じにくい → 09 で crossfade 6

hota_burning.char: The long-orange-haired swordswoman in dark armor and a torn red skirt stands tall and proud in the same right-facing stance with a confident, fearless smile, holding a slender sword low in her right hand with the blade pointing down and forward, her left arm relaxed at her side with an open hand.
hota_burning.motion: Like a confident fighting game heroine, she keeps her back perfectly straight, chest out and chin up the whole time. Only her knees give a light rhythmic springy bounce, so her whole upright body rises and sinks a little without leaning forward. Her shoulders rise and fall with calm breathing and the sword tip rises and dips in time.
hota_burning.sway: Her very long orange hair and the torn red cloth panels sway and follow through with the bounce. No fire, no flames, no glow.
hota_burning.neg: hunched back, slouching, stooping, leaning forward, bending at the waist, looking down, head drooping, tired, weak
hota_burning.note: 燃焼差分。膝で弾む書き方（hotab）は猫背になった。背筋・胸を張る・顎を上げる＋neg に猫背で直した

hiyo.char: The blonde elf support mage with a ponytail and red hair bow, a red and gold cape and a layered red and white dress keeps the same right-facing ready stance, holding her long ornate staff diagonally in front of her body with both hands.
hiyo.motion: Like a fighting game character, she makes a steady rhythmic springy idle motion in place: her knees clearly bend and straighten, her hips and torso dip down and rise back up, her shoulders rise and fall with her breathing, and the staff rises and dips in time while both hands keep their grip.
hiyo.sway: Her ponytail, the red hair ribbons, the cape and the layered skirt sway and follow through with the bounce. The staff stays straight and rigid with the same gold finial and red gem.
hiyo.note: 支援役の構え。落ち着いた立ち姿の書き方（別セッション v3/v4）は止まった。seed 2022 が採用（3033 は部位がばらばら、5055 は屈伸が大きすぎ）
